text:
maria_marketing: Quick check — launching paid search + retarget sweep tomorrow 9am PT. Plan: 3 headlines, dynamic retarget creative, budget ramp over 3 days. Need confirm on CTA variants and inbound routing. cc @owen_growth
own_growth: sounds good. can we keep day1 budget ~20% and only enable retarget audience staging after we hit ~100 clicks?
maria_marketing: yes day1 20% then 50% day2, 80% day3. retarget will be ON but audiences staged (warm/engaged only). jess, pls confirm creative specs and pixel readiness.
jess_dsp: creative sizes ok. compress to 3 variations: demo-led, feature-led, case-study snippet. we'll A/B headlines and CTAs: "Try free" / "Watch demo" / "See benchmarks". also recommend bid cap to control volatility — set `max_cpc=4` in campaign config.
chris_analytics: tagging: please use utm_source=paid_rollout, utm_campaign=smart_rollout_q2, utm_term={{keyword}}. I'll wire inbound rule to route MQLs to SDR queue 'webinar-sdr' if lead_score>65.
maria_marketing: @chris_analytics perfect. Also want first-touch webhook to HubSpot to assign `owner=owen_growth` for first 48h, then round-robin to SDRs.
own_growth: i'll own handoff day1-2, then hand off to SDRs on day3. can we give SDRs a 1-pager: talking points + top 3 objections + webinar CTA?
jess_dsp: recommend `creative_refresh=true` at 48h if CTR drops >15% vs baseline. we can auto-swap to variant B and push new headlines. also set creative rotation to even for first 24h to collect signals.
adops-bot: Campaign job queued: campaign_id=cp_2026_1802, start=2026-03-23T16:00:00Z, pools=[search-main, retarget-nodes]
maria_marketing: monitoring: set slack alerts in #marketing-alerts for CPA > $50 and conversion drop >20% vs expected. also daily digest to #marketing with top-performing keywords.
chris_analytics: i'll create dashboard and alert runbook. propose a 10% holdback control group to measure uplift — geo split US-East holdback.
own_growth: yes on holdback 10%. also want a soft cap on spend so we can pause after 24h if CTR < 0.5% on search.
jess_dsp: creatives uploaded to Drive: /drive/paid/q2/smart_rollout. pixel firing confirmed on landing page (gtm event: paid_landing_view).
adops-bot: Campaign job started: cp_2026_1802 running. status=running, nodes_allocated=6
maria_marketing: any blockers?
jess_dsp: none from creative side. final QA done on mobile/responsive.
chris_analytics: will run hourly checks first 48h and post anomalies. setting alert to notify @owen_growth + #marketing-alerts.
own_growth: i'll schedule a 1hr sync + 24h check in calendar. will handoff playbook doc after day2. :rocket:
